description.en: A generic electrical component for dry indoor residential circuits. Match the stated gauge, current or module configuration to the project and have the installation checked locally. This listing is for copper building wire for indoor branch circuits, 1.5 square millimeter gauge for lighting.

Este anúncio apresenta fio de cobre para circuito elétrico interno, bitola de 1,5 milímetro quadrado para iluminação.
